reason: The README describes a security-assessment plugin centered on scoped network scanning, HTTP probing, shell execution, finding validation, evidence storage, and assessment reporting; its network and red-team capabilities warrant human review.

summaries.zh: 用于在授权范围内执行网络与应用层安全评估、验证发现并记录证据和生成报告的 DeepSeek Harness 插件。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for conducting authorized network and application security assessments, validating findings, recording evidence, and generating reports.

capabilities: Authorized network port scanning and HTTP probing
Durable SQLite and full-text evidence recording
Automated security assessment workflows with specialist subagents
Optional red-team profile without a mechanical scope guard
